recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fills the missing published FM decision in the authoritative active StructureDefinition source without editing generated diagram artifacts; generated outputs can be refreshed by the normal FHIR build.
issue_request: FHIR-37869 is a Published/Persuasive FM change request raised against R4B and applied for R5. It requests adding patientPaid 0..1 Money to all levels of ClaimResponse.addItem.
initial_application: No current-history commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37869. The 2022-08-07 commit 75e9d09e288b16ae6531e19fbaffff9380ebf942 added patientPaid to Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit and added ClaimResponse addItem tax elements, but ClaimResponse never received addItem patientPaid. The active ClaimResponse source had no patientPaid elements before this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-30276 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification supporting decision that introduced the patientPaid pattern in Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit, including ExplanationOfBenefit addItem levels, and also discussed patient payment adjudication categories for ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit. FHIR-37869 is the narrower follow-on for ClaimResponse added-item levels. ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, and no relevant or conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Edited source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml to add patientPaid 0..1 Money to ClaimResponse.addItem, ClaimResponse.addItem.detail, and ClaimResponse.addItem.detail.subDetail, mirroring the existing Claim/ExplanationOfBenefit patientPaid definition and requirements and placing each element before quantity.

related_jiras.note: Established the patientPaid wording and adjacent Claim/ExplanationOfBenefit implementation pattern that FHIR-37869 extends to ClaimResponse addItem levels.
